_comment: This lived only on the server until now, like iax.conf did - and a reboot
already proved once what that costs: Redis lost the trunk and every call
rang and died with nothing in any log explaining why.
`numbers` is deliberately empty so the trunk matches any called number.
Security comes from allowed_addresses: only our own Asterisk can use it.
headers_to_attributes carries the dialler's per-call context through to the
agent. Asterisk puts these on the INVITE (see [recsetup] in
extensions.conf); livekit-sip turns them into participant attributes; the
agent reads them and gives the model a caller-context block.
The attribute names are prefixed `dialer.` on purpose. LiveKit owns the
`sip.` namespace - sip.callIDFull, sip.trunkPhoneNumber - and colliding with
it would be a bug that only appears when LiveKit adds a field.
NOTE: LiveKit's docs warn these attributes are populated ASYNCHRONOUSLY, so
they may not be present the instant the participant joins. The agent waits a
bounded moment for them and logs when they never arrive, rather than
silently greeting a named caller as a stranger.
